asset_policy.canonical_rule: When a canonical asset exists, use that exact approved asset or an explicitly approved variant. Do not regenerate a similar substitute.
asset_policy.verification_rule: File path, hash, dimensions, and variant status must be verified before they are treated as canonical metadata.
asset_policy.unknown_rule: Use null or PENDING_VERIFICATION rather than inventing metadata.
